rawContent: From everything I'm reading, Oprah and Streep and other big names effectively co-opted the #metoo campaign. But are they really defenders of such people as @rosemcgowan   Where were they before now? Oh yeah, uptight  w/Weinstein.  Rose, they stole your thunder for their own gain.

Once Rose is out of the way, a new and more expedient look can be given to #MeToo and better yet it can morph into a twofer. Tie it with racism. Hot damn! Now we have a political movement.  But what about @rosemcgowan and others?  They can wait.
